d: Namaste, Hyundai India just launched its brand-new SUV, the Bayon. It is a 4-meter-plus SUV that will sit between the Venue and the Creta. But unlike the Creta and the Venue, this car will come with only one engine: a 1.5L NA Petrol engine. This is the same engine we have seen in various Hyundai cars before, producing 114 ps of power and 143.8 Nm of torque. The price starts at Rs 9.99 lakh for the base HX2 manual engine option and goes all the way to 17.99 lakh for the top-end HX10 IVT Trim.
